cells: **CC0 1.0 — verified IN THE ASSET HEADERS themselves, 2026-08-11 (#337), not a pack page:** `low-poly.mhclo`, `low-poly.obj` and `materials/brown.mhmat` each carry *"This asset was explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020"* with copyright holders Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier. The surrounding `makehuman2` repo is AGPL — this does NOT infect these assets; the headers are the per-asset grant, and the same eyes ship inside the separately-packaged `makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip`. **`brown_eye.png` (the `diffuseTexture` the `brown.mhmat` declares) is part of the SAME CC0 release, verified 2026-08-11 (#340):** 610,817 bytes, git blob `bda1b4b0d94f4b7b34ca4f58063eab04f05cd2e7` == upstream `main` byte-for-byte (gh API), no licence text chunks inside the PNG, so the grant is read from the declaring `brown.mhmat` header in the same directory — the same header-only standard #337 held.

`low-poly` eye pair: `low-poly.mhclo` + `low-poly.obj` (96 verts / 86 quads ≈ 172 tris) + `brown.mhmat` + `brown_eye.png` (1024² RGBA). **Topology note:** all 96 fit refs are helper verts 14598–14741 (≥ 13,380) — the eye fit MUST run before the #318 helper strip, and does.

`materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py` eye fit (#337) via MPFB's proven `HumanService.add_mhclo_asset(asset_type="eyes", material_type="PROCEDURAL_EYES")`, bound to the standard rig's `eyeL`/`eyeR` by `add_mhclo_asset`'s own `interpolate_weights` (probe: dominant groups `eye.L` 48 / `eye.R` 48 — the k-NN garment projection was measured wrong for eyes and is not used). **#340: the eye material now consumes the asset's own `brown.mhmat` — `diffuseTexture brown_eye.png` bound as glTF `baseColorTexture` via the generic `make_material_from_mhmat` path (was: flat white, then flat brown — neither was an eye); `brown_eye.png` staged in `.openclinxr-local/provider-cache/eyes/makehuman-default/`**

**Keep.** CC0 is the cleanest posture; replace only on quality grounds (the low-poly default is deliberately low-poly — a high-poly eye exists at `data/eyes/hm08/high-poly/`, same CC0 header, if fidelity demands it).
